title: Weekend Veggie Chilli
ingredients: 2 large carrots, peeled and finely chopped
400g can black beans, drained and rinsed
400g can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
Spice mix: 2 tsp chilli powder, 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt
steps: Mix all spice mix ingredients together.
Fry onion, celery and leek in cooking spray for 10 minutes; add garlic, carrots and peppers; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Pour in tomatoes, water, black beans and pinto beans; add tomato purée, soy sauce, vinegar and spice mix; stir thoroughly.
Bring to a rapid simmer; lid on; bake in oven for 1 hour until rich, dark and all vegetables tender.
notes: Great with leftover vegetables — sweet potato, butternut squash, parsnips, mushrooms, sweetcorn. Can be made in advance and reheated. Freezer-friendly.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
